instructions: Please answer the following questions as accurately as possible.

questions.body: I would like P&G to share my personal information with its advertising partners to show me, and others like me, news and updates about P&G careers and roles through online channels such as LinkedIn, Instagram, Meta, Facebook, Google, TikTok, and YouTube. Your decision to opt-in or opt-out will not disqualify you from participating in P&G’s recruitment process and you may opt-out at any time.
Have you either graduated within the past 6 months, or are you an active student?

Our thorough and purposeful hiring process ensures that we recruit top talent to join us at P&G – talent with a complete understanding of who we are, what we do and what we expect from you. In line with our Purpose, Values, and Principles (PVP), we value fairness, objectivity and ethical practices in our talent assessment and interview processes. As an applicant to a role within P&G, you are expected to adhere to the following guidelines to ensure a fair and equitable experience for everyone:

•  Use the same profile/account throughout the application process, and contact technical support if you have any issues with an existing profile

•  Complete all stages of the selection process (e.g., assessment, interview) independently and without any help – from others or the use of Artificial Intelligence

•  Provide answers and information throughout the application, assessment and interview process that accurately describes you, your experiences and interests

•  Respect the integrity of the P&G selection process and do not copy or share the assessment content or materials in any capacity (e.g., screenshots, recordings)

•  Avoid sharing any highly confidential/proprietary information received throughout the application and interview process

I acknowledge I will adhere to these expectations throughout the application process.
What source(s) of information influenced your decision to apply for a P&G position?

Do you or any immediate family members (spouse, partner, parent, child, or sibling) have any personal, financial, or professional relationships that could be perceived as a conflict of interest with our organization or the position for which you are applying?
